info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Management Update API enables businesses to modify existing customer product information using specified parameters. This API allows users to update customer details such as product classifications, benefits, or account statuses. Typical consumers include banking and financial institutions that require real-time updates to customer records as part of their service management processes. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance accuracy and compliance within their customer management systems.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific product associated with a customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields in the request body to perform the update successfully.

requestBody.description: Updates the specified customer's product details by providing the necessary changes in the request body. The identifiers should be used to specify which details require updating.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
